title: Pharaoh Rejects Moses

questions.question: What did Moses and Aaron ask Pharaoh to let Israel do?
options: Go three days into the wilderness to sacrifice
questions.correctAnswer: Go three days into the wilderness to sacrifice
questions.explanation: Exodus 5:1, 3 (ESV): "Let my people go, that they may hold a feast to me in the wilderness... a three days' journey into the wilderness."

questions.question: How did Pharaoh respond to Moses and Aaron's request?
options: He refused, saying he did not know the Lord
questions.correctAnswer: He refused, saying he did not know the Lord
questions.explanation: Exodus 5:2 (ESV): "Who is the Lord, that I should obey his voice and let Israel go? I do not know the Lord, and moreover, I will not let Israel go."

questions.question: What did Pharaoh demand the Israelites do without straw?
options: Make the same quota of bricks
questions.correctAnswer: Make the same quota of bricks
questions.explanation: Exodus 5:7-8 (ESV): "You shall no longer give the people straw to make bricks... but the number of bricks that they made in the past you shall impose on them."

questions.question: What material did the Israelites need to make bricks?
questions.explanation: Exodus 5:7 (ESV): "You shall no longer give the people straw to make bricks as in the past."

questions.question: Who did the Israelite foremen blame for their increased hardship?
questions.explanation: Exodus 5:21 (ESV): "They said to them, 'The Lord look on you and judge, because you have made us stink in the sight of Pharaoh.'"

questions.question: What reason did Pharaoh give for increasing the Israelites' workload?
options: They were idle and wanted to go sacrifice
questions.correctAnswer: They were idle and wanted to go sacrifice
questions.explanation: Exodus 5:8 (ESV): "For they are idle. Therefore they cry, 'Let us go and offer sacrifice to our God.'"

questions.question: What did the Israelites have to do when straw was no longer provided?
questions.explanation: Exodus 5:12 (ESV): "So the people were scattered throughout all the land of Egypt to gather stubble for straw."

questions.question: What did Moses ask God after Pharaoh's refusal made things worse?
options: "Why have you done evil to this people? Why did you ever send me?"
For permission to return to Midian
questions.correctAnswer: "Why have you done evil to this people? Why did you ever send me?"
questions.explanation: Exodus 5:22-23 (ESV): "O Lord, why have you done evil to this people?... you have not delivered your people at all."

questions.question: Who beat the Israelite foremen for not meeting the brick quota?
questions.explanation: Exodus 5:14 (ESV): "The foremen of the people of Israel... were beaten."

questions.question: To whom did the Israelite foremen appeal after being beaten?
questions.explanation: Exodus 5:15 (ESV): "Then the foremen of the people of Israel came and cried to Pharaoh."

questions.question: What did Pharaoh call the words of Moses and Aaron?
questions.explanation: Exodus 5:9 (ESV): "Let heavier work be laid on the men that they may labor at it and pay no regard to lying words."

questions.question: What accusation did Pharaoh make about the Israelites wanting to sacrifice?
questions.explanation: Exodus 5:17 (ESV): "You are idle, you are idle; that is why you say, 'Let us go and sacrifice to the Lord.'"

questions.question: According to Exodus 5:21, what did the foremen say Moses and Aaron had done?
options: Made them stink in the sight of Pharaoh
questions.correctAnswer: Made them stink in the sight of Pharaoh
questions.explanation: Exodus 5:21 (ESV): "You have made us stink in the sight of Pharaoh and his servants, and have put a sword in their hand to kill us."

questions.question: What complaint did Moses make to God about the outcome of confronting Pharaoh?
options: God had not delivered His people at all
questions.correctAnswer: God had not delivered His people at all
questions.explanation: Exodus 5:23 (ESV): "For since I came to Pharaoh to speak in your name, he has done evil to this people, and you have not delivered your people at all."

questions.question: Where did Moses and Aaron meet the Israelite foremen after they left Pharaoh?
options: They were waiting for them when they came out from Pharaoh
questions.correctAnswer: They were waiting for them when they came out from Pharaoh
questions.explanation: Exodus 5:20 (ESV): "They met Moses and Aaron, who were waiting for them, as they came out from Pharaoh."

key_verse_text: But Pharaoh said, ‘Who is the Lord, that I should obey his voice and let Israel go? I do not know the Lord, and moreover, I will not let Israel go.’
